checks.name: function_identity
checks.rationale: Binary Ninja identifies App_ContextSetTerrainLightmapsUsed at 0x0048F260; the address-qualified GameNatives body and candidate target the same entry.

checks.name: argument_mapping
checks.rationale: Retail MOVSX EAX, byte ptr [ESP+4] sign-extends the cdecl byte input; the candidate accepts std::int8_t.

checks.name: constants_and_scaling
checks.rationale: No constants or scaling; the promoted input is stored and returned unchanged.

checks.name: memory_layout_and_access
checks.rationale: Retail writes EAX to 0x005C8BE8. The port maps this global to AppContextState::terrain_lightmaps_used and stores the same 32-bit value.

checks.name: calls_and_side_effects
checks.rationale: One retail global write and no calls; the candidate has one corresponding field write and no calls.

checks.name: return_and_error_paths
checks.rationale: RET leaves the MOVSX result in EAX; no branches or error paths.

limits: The retail x86 body is compared using Radare2 ESIL rather than a live IGI.exe process.
Candidate maps the retail absolute global to port-owned AppContextState.
